title: 第一卷 第9章 退婚第一卷 第10章 赵龙腾的威胁
lines: “爹，你说秦玄还会来吗？”
柳家，柳依依有些紧张的拉着父亲衣袖问道。
虽说有赵家少主为她撑腰，可是真到了这天，她还是一阵紧张。
“他敢！”
柳生冷笑一声。
“他们秦家在火风城或许算是一方霸主，可和赵家这种玄龙道大家族相比，那就是天差地别！”
“女儿你放心，就算他来，那也是给你和咱们柳家道歉！”
“咱们柳家已经不是之前的柳家了！”
“他们秦家怎么能和赵家这种庞然大物相提并论！”
柳依依心中大定，有些趾高气扬地点了点头。
“没错，这件事从头到尾都是秦玄的错，他要是敢来，那就一定要打断他的腿！”
“到时候我看赵少主上门兴师问罪，他秦玄还能说什么！”
有了赵龙腾这个靠山，柳家众人这时候自然心中大定。
不少人觉得秦家在得知这个消息后根本就不敢来！
与此同时，秦玄和三长老秦炎两人出现在了柳家门口。
看到秦玄走了过来，负责看门的一个柳家弟子立即讥讽一笑。
“吆，这不是秦家少族长嘛？今天是哪阵风把你给吹来了？”
“想见依依小姐是吧，不好意思，依依小姐吩咐过了，除了赵龙腾赵少主之外，其他闲杂人等一概不见！”
若是正常，这些柳家侍卫自然是不敢对秦家少族长如此不敬。
可一来秦玄以前跪舔柳依依，这些侍卫早就见过秦玄那卑微的样子根本就不把他放在眼里。
二来则是因为赵龙腾。
有了赵家少主撑腰，这些柳家弟子自然是越发猖狂。
看到秦玄冷着脸站在门口。
几个柳家弟子不屑地摇了摇头。
“这年头，什么阿猫阿狗都想进我们柳家了？也不撒泡尿照照自己......”
柳家弟子话音未落，秦玄瞬间动了。
用力在地上一踩，秦玄就像是离弦之箭一般，瞬间冲到了这个柳家弟子面前，朝着对方脸上就是狠狠的一巴掌。
“咔嚓！”
骨骼碎裂的声音传了出来。
这个柳家弟子被秦玄一巴掌直接扇飞了出去，重重的砸在了大门上，将大门砸开。
“你算个什么，竟然敢拦我！”
content_en:
"Dad, do you think Qin Xuan will come again?"
In the Liu family, Liu Yiyi pulled her father's sleeve nervously and asked.
Although the young master of the Zhao family supported her, she was still nervous when the day came.
"He dares!"
Yagyu sneered.
"The Qin family may be considered the overlord in Huofeng City, but compared with a big Xuanlong Dao family like the Zhao family, there is a world of difference!"
"Don't worry, daughter, even if he comes, he will apologize to you and our Liu family!"
"Our Liu family is no longer the Liu family before!"
"How can the Qin family be compared with such a behemoth as the Zhao family!"
Liu Yiyi was determined and nodded arrogantly.
"Yes, this matter is Qin Xuan's fault from beginning to end. If he dares to come, then his legs must be broken!"
"When the time comes, I see Young Master Zhao come to ask for help. What else can Qin Xuan say?"
With Zhao Longteng as their backer, everyone in the Liu family was naturally at ease.
Many people felt that the Qin family did not dare to come after learning the news!
At the same time, Qin Xuan and the third elder Qin Yan appeared at the door of Liu's house.
Seeing Qin Xuan coming over, a disciple of the Liu family who was responsible for guarding the door immediately smiled sarcastically.
"Hey, isn't this the young patriarch of the Qin family? What kind of wind brought you here today?"
"You want to see Miss Yiyi, right? Sorry, Miss Yiyi has given instructions. Except for Zhao Longteng and Young Master Zhao, no other people will be seen!"
If it were normal, these Liu family guards would naturally not dare to be so disrespectful to the young patriarch of the Qin family.
But when Qin Xuan knelt down and licked Liu Yiyi before, these guards had already seen Qin Xuan's humble appearance and didn't take him seriously at all.
Secondly, it was because of Zhao Longteng.
With the support of the young master of the Zhao family, these Liu family disciples naturally became more and more aggressive.
He saw Qin Xuan standing at the door with a cold face.
Several Liu family disciples shook their heads in disdain.
"These days, all the cats and dogs want to enter our Liu family? Why don't you take a pee and take a look at yourself..."
Before the disciple of the Liu family finished speaking, Qin Xuan moved instantly.
Stomping hard on the ground, Qin Xuan rushed to the Liu family disciple like an arrow from a string and slapped him hard on the face.
"Crack!"
The sound of broken bones was heard.
The disciple of the Liu family was slapped by Qin Xuan and flew out. He hit the door hard and broke it open.
"Who do you think you are, how dare you stop me!"
